Benefit Claim Details

Eligibility
Yes
Reason
The applicant qualifies for SNAP benefits as their gross monthly
income of $900 is below the maximum allowable income of $3,350
for a household size of 3. After applying the standard deduction of
$198, their net income is $702. The calculated benefit amount is
$679.70, which is rounded to $679.70.

Missouri Department of
Social Services
Application for Supplemental Nutrition
Assistance Program (SNAP)

To apply:
• You have the right to apply for SNAP benefits at any time.
• If an interview is required, it can be completed by phone or in
  person. An interview is required in most cases.
• Family Support Division (FSD) will attempt to call you, if
  you provided a phone number on the application, the next
  business day after your application is registered to complete
  an interview. Answering this phone call is the quickest way to
  complete your interview.
• If you did not provide a phone number, or if you are unable to
  complete your interview at the time we call, please call (855)
  823-4908 to complete your interview or visit an FSD office to
  complete this as soon as possible. (Review the next page for
  more information about what to do after you’ve submitted
  your SNAP Application).
• We may ask you for proof of some of the information you give
  to FSD.
• Please write as neatly as possible.

Ways to return a SNAP application:
Upload:
mydssupload.mo.gov
Mail:
Family Support
Division PO Box 2700
Jefferson City, MO 65102
In Person:
Find an office:
dss.mo.gov/offices.htm
Fax:
573-526-9400

Date of application:
Benefits are provided from the date FSD receives your application, which must contain your name, address and
signature. Please complete sections 2 through 6 to help FSD process your application faster.
If approved, your SNAP benefits are provided from the date FSD receives your application. This is your filing date. If you
are in an institution and apply for SNAP benefits and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) at the same time, your filing
date is the date of release from the institution.

Authorized Representative:
You can choose more than one person or facility to complete your application and/or manage your benefits on
your behalf. They will act as your authorized representative. If you want an authorized representative, complete the
Authorized Representative Form (IM-6AR) at https://dssmanuals.mo.gov/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/im-6ar-app.pdf
or call FSD.

Applying for SNAP just got faster and easier.
Apply online at: https://mydss.mo.gov/apply

The Benefit Application tab is selected, displaying AI-generated benefit claim details and fraud risk analysis on the left, while a PDF viewer on the right shows the first page of a SNAP application supporting document. Approve and Deny buttons are available at the top for the reviewer’s decision.
extraction.step_instructions: Review the automatic recommendation, eligibility reason, monthly benefit calculation, and fraud risk analysis. Compare the details against the SNAP application document shown in the PDF viewer. Click on Approve if the recommendation is correct, or click on Deny if the claim should not be approved.
